'''''Prangos trifida''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] native to southern Europe.<ref name=":0">{{cite POWO |id=847489-1 |title=''Prangos trifida'' |access-date=27 November 2023}}</ref> It occurs in France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Albania,<ref name=":0" /><!-- The source maps Yugoslavia. But the country of Yugoslavia no longer exists. --> Serbia, Kosovo, Macedonia, Romania, Bulgaria, and Crimea.<ref>{{Catalogue of Life|id=4M8X4|title=''Prangos trifida''|access-date=27 November 2023}}</ref>
